items.title: Butch Cage and Robert Pete Williams Interview, 1967-05-13
items.q: He was a mean looking man, Mr. Barney, though... He said, I've seen a man milking, but I've never seen a man beat you milking a cow.

ctx.x: That's the one you got now? No, that's not the one I got now. This was a assignment that I had. It sounded like an electric box. She sold it to me and she said, I paid, well, in that time, you could get a guitar, a cheap can, for about $50 or $60. She told me she'd pay $60 for that guitar. She said, that son of mine is not interested in you. She said, I said, for $4. She sold it to me. For $4? $4. So I'd taken that guitar and I went on, went on. I got more and more with it, you know?
